annotation.title_clean: Moonshot Goal 3 Call for Proposals: Recruitment and Selection Policy (general-purpose autonomous humanoid AI robots)
annotation.title_en: Moonshot Goal 3 Call for Proposals: Recruitment and Selection Policy (general-purpose autonomous humanoid AI robots)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Moonshot R&D Program, Goal 3 Program Director (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Moonshot Goal 3 call for proposals seeking R&D on general-purpose autonomous humanoid AI robots by 2050. It defines three research categories (Integrated, Specialized, Elemental) with budgets, selection criteria, 2030 prototype targets, ELSI inclusion, industry-academia collaboration and security considerations in international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Goal: AI robots that autonomously learn, adapt and act alongside humans by 2050
Three categories: Integrated (3bn yen), Specialized (1bn yen), Elemental (100m yen)
Integrated research must address ELSI and industry-academia collaboration
2030 target: prototype humanoid suitable for private investment
International collaboration proposals must consider security
